# asdf-plugin buildout rules (plugin) — run ONCE during repo creation, then
# discarded. They verify the plugin was wired to the asdf script contract and split
# from its host-tool integration at setup.
version: 1.1

rules:
  - name: plugin_never_calls_asdf
    description: |
      true when no plugin script in the target files invokes `asdf`. false when any
      plugin script shells back out to `asdf` (for example `asdf reshim` from
      `install`).
    files:
      include: ["bin/**", "lib/**"]

  - name: plugin_split_from_host_tool_integration
    description: |
      true when the plugin project is rooted at the repo root — asdf requires
      `bin/` to sit there, so this project alone cannot be moved into a
      subdirectory — holding the scripts, any shared `lib/`, and the offline
      `bats` tests, while the host-tool integration that installs a real version
      over the network is a separate project with its own directory and project
      definition, depending on the plugin. false when `asdf plugin test` is a
      target of the plugin project itself, so editing a `bats` fixture installs a
      real tool version, or when the plugin's `bin/` was relocated to make the
      layout uniform and the host tool can no longer find it.
    files:
      include: ["nx.json", "**/project.json", "bin/**", "**/*.bats"]
